Question: Two cards are dealt from a deck of four red cards labeled \(A,\) \(B,\) \(C,\) \(D\) and four green cards labeled \(A,\) \(B,\) \(C,\) \(D.\) A winning pair is two of the same color or two of the same letter. What is the probability of drawing a winning pair?
